summary: IonQ filed an 8-K reporting completion on November 3, 2026, of its acquisition of all outstanding shares of Elisity, Inc. under a merger agreement dated October 9, 2026, via subsidiary Espresso Acquisition Sub, Inc. Closing consideration was 32,233,274 IonQ shares, plus up to 4,265,934 earn-out shares contingent on financial metrics through January 2028, totaling up to 36,499,208 shares. A Registration Rights Agreement grants recipients registration rights; shares issued under Section 4(a)(2)/Reg D/S exemptions. Watch earn-out triggers, registration-driven overhang, and integration execution.
